3. The present application under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, has been filed by the Applicant- Rajesh Kumar, S/o Shri Harsh Roop Singh, with a prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 19.10.2022, the cognizance order dated 21.10.2022, and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 7094 of 2022, titled "State vs. Shoorveer Singh & Others," for offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 409, and 120B of the Indian Penal Code,1860 as well as Sections 3, 4, 5, 9, and 10 of the Uttar Pradesh Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1998,
pending before the Court of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun, District Dehradun.
